payload.note: Cannot authorize a release: test deployment id, zero verifying contract, zero cost cap, one-hour expiry.

conclusion: A real browser-extension wallet on X Layer 196 signed the same EIP-712 struct the API verifies, and an independent offline tool recovered the owner address. This proves the wallet -> signature -> verification path end to end without any mainnet write.
gaps: deviceNote is empty, so the exact extension name/version and browser were not recorded; it is optional for the injected path but required for hardware.
WalletConnect pairing reached the QR + relay handshake (see walletconnect-qr.png and the relay/attestation log) but no phone wallet completed the session.
No hardware device was used; that path remains HUMAN_REQUIRED.
